req.title: Reject empty title on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field of POST /tasks/ is missing.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return an HTTP 422 status code when the title field is missing in a POST request to create a task. This behavior needs to be validated through a series of tests that cover positive, negative, and boundary cases. The tests ensure that the system behaves correctly when the title is provided, when it is missing, and when it is at the boundary of its constraints.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_valid_title
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid title.
expected: The response contains the task with the provided title.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Valid Task", "description": "A valid task description", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "Valid Task"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_missing_title
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ without a title.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"description": "Missing title", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_create_task_with_empty_title
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an empty title.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "", "description": "Empty title", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 422
